notes.title: Succubus Contract version 1.2 is out!
notes.notes:
changes:
-fixed some minor bugs
-Added Portuguese language (special thanks to Mephiros)
-Added Russian languag  (special thanks to TRexVovan)
-Added information when buying and giving gifts, now you can see what girls like
-tasks for girls have been changed, now you can improve a relationship with them much faster

notes.title: Succubus Contract version 1.1 is out!
notes.notes:

-fixed English text
-Added the possibility to skip the date change screen
( press any button on the keyboard or mouse )
-cheats added to game, information can be found in the community https://steamcommunity.com/app/1062220/discussions/0/1636410430567766262/
